voice_instruct: Young adult female in her early twenties, bright warm mezzo voice, playful and a little mischievous, confident storyteller energy, expressive rising and falling pitch, natural breaths, a smile in the voice, quick but clear pacing, American accent.
ref_text: Okay, okay, listen. I have a story for you, and I promise, you are not going to believe how it ends.

lines.text: Stop scrolling. In nineteen sixty-two, three men escaped from Alcatraz using spoons, paint, and fake heads made of soap.
The guards counted them every single night. Every night, the heads were in the beds.
And then one morning... nobody answered.
They were never found. Not once. So where did they go? Tell me your theory, and follow for part two.
